title: Embedded snippet lab: interactive mini-snippets for auth, streaming & tool-calls
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Design and deliver a compact, embeddable "mini-lab" UI component that surfaces 3 interactive code snippet experiences used in SDK/API onboarding docs: 1) auth & key rotation quick demo, 2) streaming response pattern with client-side event visuals, and 3) tool-calling sample that wires a mock external tool. The mini-lab should be small enough to embed inline in docs pages (mobile and desktop), include copy variants for developer and product audiences, and ship with a set of static PNG screenshots + animated GIFs for release notes. Output assets must include accessible color variants and concise microcopy for each step.
acceptance_criteria: Three distinct snippet experiences implemented as design comps: auth, streaming, tool-call
Static screenshot sets (mobile/desktop) and 3x small GIFs demonstrating flow playback
Copy variants for 2 audiences: developer-focused and product-focused
Design tokens and spacing to fit existing docs style guide; responsive breakpoints defined
Handoff package uploaded to Drive + Figma with annotations for engineering
Preview build (storybook) with clipped snippets for legal/security review
tasks: Outline micro-lab interaction states and failure fallbacks
Create low-fi wireframes for each snippet (auth, streaming, tool-call)
Produce hi-fi comps in Figma with annotated copy and alt text
Export screenshots (2 sizes) and 3 animated GIFs for each flow
Coordinate with Docs engineer to embed snippet and test in staging
Collect feedback during design review and iterate
Prepare PRD blurb for product release notes and marketing
